headline: It is not just
body: a target for hormones made elsewhere. | Growth plate cartilage carries the **enzymes** to rebuild them on site. | Both of them.
punch: One tissue. Two conversion pathways. Opposite outcomes.

headline: Path one
body: *Aromatase* converts testosterone into **estradiol**. | Researchers detected aromatase transcripts by RT-PCR directly in human growth plate tissue. | Taken from adolescents during epiphysiodesis surgery.
punch: Human tissue. Not a mouse. Not a cell line.

headline: And the plate
body: responds to what it makes. | A human chondrocyte cell line produced 17 beta estradiol and reacted to it. | Proliferation and apoptosis both changed.
punch: It manufactures its own closure signal.

headline: That estradiol
body: acts on estrogen receptors in your *chondrocytes*. | Chondrocytes are the cartilage cells that divide to lengthen bone. | Estrogen tells them to stop and the plate ossifies.
punch: This is how you close. Locally.

headline: Path two
body: *5 alpha reductase* converts testosterone into **DHT**. | Human fetal epiphyseal cartilage metabolises testosterone directly. | Cultured human epiphyseal chondrocytes carry specific DHT binding sites.
punch: Functional androgen receptors, in the cartilage itself.

headline: And here is why
body: that matters. | **DHT cannot aromatise.** It is a dead end for the estrogen pathway. | Testosterone that becomes DHT can never become estradiol.
punch: One path builds. The other path ends you.

headline: Which explains
body: why non aromatisable androgens behave differently. | *Oxandrolone* across **45 studies** in paediatric growth disorders. | Growth velocity of **4.5 to 9.6 cm per year**.
punch: And 2.3 to 4.6 cm of additional adult height.

headline: That is not
body: what a compound that closes plates does. | The evidence spans constitutional delay, Turner syndrome and burn recovery. | Real clinical populations, real final height measurements.

headline: But the same review
body: found the tradeoff. | Skeletal maturation still advanced **3 to 7 months**. | Adverse effects were dose dependent, clustering above **0.06 mg per kg per day**.
punch: Virilisation appeared in 12.5 to 15.2% at those doses.

headline: So low dose
body: gained height. High dose spent bone age. | The same compound does both depending on how much you use. | This is a dose response, not a yes or no.
punch: More is not the same direction as some.

headline: Which is the whole point
body: How much testosterone becomes estradiol versus DHT at the plate decides whether you grow or close. | That split shifts with dose and with age. | And it happens locally, where no blood test can see it.
punch: Ask what it becomes. Not how much you took.

headline: It's never over
body: Real mechanisms. Real citations. No protocols.
